Reviewer dimension: SIGN
Paper summary: This paper proposes a method called Latent Sympathetic Examples (LSE) to explain why a neural network misclassifies an image. The approach uses a generative model (VAE or VAE-GAN) to find a small perturbation in the latent space that, when applied to the image, causes the classifier to predict the correct class. The resulting perturbation is intended to be visually interpretable, thereby providing an intuitive explanation for the error. The method is evaluated on MNIST and CelebA.
